about: US dollars per million tokens. Cache prices follow Anthropic's usual multipliers (read 0.1x, write 1.25x input). Unknown models use 'default', priced high on purpose so a cap is never undercounted. eleven_flash_v2_5 counts characters as input and is priced 0 for the ElevenLabs free plan (paid is about 50 per million characters); its own monthly character cap applies instead. anam counts planned avatar seconds as input and is priced 0: Anam bills per minute on its own plan, capped by ANAM_MONTHLY_MINUTE_CAP.
